fix: recognize replaceAll in unsafe-json-in-html rule (#2011)

Fixes #2010

The unsafe-json-in-html rule now recognizes .replaceAll("<", "\u003c")
and variants as safe escape patterns, equivalent to the already-recognized
.replace(/</g, "\u003c") form.

Added comprehensive regression tests covering:
- Safe patterns: replaceAll with \u003c, \u003C, and < replacements
- Unsafe patterns: wrong search character and non-escaping replacements
